newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to build $43 mln hydrogen peroxide plant.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to build $43 mln hydrogen peroxide plant.

text.p: Turkey's state mining company Etibank and private local group Garipoglu will jointly build a $43-million hydrogene peroxide plant in western Turkey, a statement from the ministry said.

The statement, issued by the office of State Minister Teoman Riza Guneri who is in charge of mining, said the plant would have an annual capacity of 20,000 tonnes, compared to Turkey's annual needs of 15,000 tonnes.
Construction work for the plant, located in Bandirma town, will be started by Guneri on Saturday with a ground-breaking ceremony, it said.
The plant, which will use the German "Uhde" technology in production, will have an economic life of 15 years and employ 64 personnel.
Hydrogen peroxide is mainly used in paper, textiles and chemical industries.
